provenance.author: CityXcape
provenance.annotation_method: Single annotator manually inspected source JPEGs before detector inference. Boxes cover visible full bodies of people at least45pixels tall whose centers lie in the fixed ROI. Explicit ignored regions cover partial or heavily occluded people.

models.fasterrcnn: TorchVision FasterRCNN MobileNetV3 Large320FPN COCO_V1; frozen pretrained weights
models.ssdlite: TorchVision SSDLite320 MobileNetV3 Large COCO_V1; frozen pretrained weights

provenance.evaluation: Greedy score-ordered one-to-one IoU>=0.5 matching inside fixedROI; minimum boxheight45pixels. Ignore partial/heavily occluded regions atIoU>=0.3 unless matched to annotatedperson. Threshold selected on developmentframes only; unscoredframes are replayonly.

limitations: One23-second Pexels clip and four sparse test frames are not a general pedestrian benchmark.
Single-annotator boxes were authored from viewed source frames before model inference; no independent second annotation review.
Development and test windows are separated in time but share a scene/camera and remain correlated.
Only the stated region and visible people at least45pixels tall are scored; ignored regions and label uncertainty affect precision/recall.
This compares two frozen pretrained detectors with development-selected confidence thresholds; no model fine-tuning was performed.
Local warmed CPU latency is measured once per sampled frame and excludes decoding, HTTP, queues, and concurrent load.
Footage is resized/JPEG-encoded for this annotated replay; no endorsement by depicted people or brands is implied.
